body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a Vercel deployment validation failure for Studio by removing a `vercel.json` `functions` glob that references a build-time artifact (`api/index.js`) which does not exist in the source tree at validation time.

**Changes:**
- Removed the `functions` block from `apps/studio/vercel.json` to avoid pre-build glob validation errors.
- Added an Unreleased changelog entry documenting the deployment issue and why the `functions` block was removed.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/studio/vercel.json | Removes `functions` configuration that pointed at a generated `api/index.js` artifact, preventing Vercel pre-build validation from failing. |
| apps/studio/CHANGELOG.md | Documents the rationale and expected behavior after removing the `functions` block. |
